links.outcome: Patient and provider ratings of clarity of LLM patient-friendly consultation summaries
links.effect: Patients agreed on clarity 100%; providers agreed on clarity 91%. Some summaries retained jargon; prompt to be optimized.
links.quote: Some of the summaries retained jargon and results from this study will be used to optimize the prompt for an expanded study.

unlisted_practices: Patient-friendly LLM-generated summaries of oncology consultations shared with patients to improve understanding and recall

screen.reason: Evaluates patient and oncologist satisfaction with LLM-generated patient-friendly consultation summaries derived from real consultation notes, without testing a comparative deployment safeguard.
